purpose: Monthly new-money guidance for Devon's held ETFs. A timing rule may change the guidance only if it passes the pre-registered walk-forward gate below against plain monthly buying.

TREND_PAUSE.description: Pause new money while the close is below its 200-session average by more than the band.

BUY_BELOW_TREND.description: Pause new money while the close is above its 200-session average by more than the band.

STRETCH_PAUSE.description: Pause new money while the total-return index is above its five-year average by more than the multiple.

WAIT_FOR_DIP.description: Hold new money until the fund is this far below its peak.

walk_forward.in_sample: backtests whose 36-month window ended before the test start, pooled across funds
walk_forward.selection: parameter with the highest mean in-sample edge

expense_ratio_sources: Issuer fund pages; QQQ 0.18% after its 2025-12-22 conversion to an open-end ETF (etf.com, Invesco Wins Approval to Convert QQQ Into a Standard ETF)
